card.name: "In" after mean change
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after "mean change" (or "mean increase") when a trial result is reported. It is followed by a measure such as weight, glucose or cholesterol.

modes.label: Mean change in a measure
modes.description: "in" after "mean change" or "mean increase" before a lab or weight measure in antipsychotic trial summaries.
modes.example: patients who received lurasidone hydrochloride tablets as monotherapy in the short-term and continued in the longer-term study had a mean change<< in>> weight of -0.02 kg

card.plain: It marks the small word "in" in "mean change in..." just before the text names which weight or lab value changed.
